label: Onboarding: Status
mcp_tool_description: Report what the appliance has configured for a proof of concept in one call: licence, portal URL, SMTP, proxy, Content Library reachability, Setup Wizard step states, every resource handler with its environments (OS builds, networks, groups, lifecycle parameters, last verify result), the Custom Server blueprint and its orders, servers left in Provision Failed state, parameters the onboarding content would reuse because one of that name already exists (parameterConflicts), groups and users (each local user's own page and whether its password is set), LDAP and SSO, which onboarding tools are installed and synchronous, the POC items recorded as done or not applicable, and nextSteps with a UI link for each. Call it at the start of every onboarding phase and after any change, before deciding what to do next. Read-only; requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
